$comment: The default 5-bot cast (docs/SPEC.md section 2). Mixing vendors gives real temperament differences. OpenRouter slugs and per-provider prices checked on 2026-11-19. priceCeiling (OpenRouter seats, US dollars per million tokens) is the most OpenRouter may charge: paid calls send it as provider.max_price, and the spend guard reserves calls at that price.
name: default

seats.note: The spec's 'DeepSeek V4 Flash'. Its 15 OpenRouter providers charge $0.07-0.14 in / $0.14-0.28 out, so the ceiling leaves most of them available. (deepseek-v4.1-flash was rejected: its 39 providers range from $0.05 to $3 in and $0.20 to $12 out.)

The priciest seat. Google's endpoints charge $0.125-0.45 in / $0.75-2.70 out; the ceiling keeps it at or below the standard $0.25 / $1.50. Gemini can reason (billed as output), so bot calls must switch reasoning off.
